config._note: retro-adjustments (2026-07-15): a PayrollAdjustment is a DELTA against a sealed original -- pa-delta leads top-left as the stat KPI an accountant reviews (the net nabetaling/terugvordering amount actually settling into the current run), pa-related sits top-right to resolve the four $ref fields (employeeId, originalPayrollRunId, originalPayslipId, settlementPayrollRunId) at matching height, and pa-data runs full-width below with the remaining record fields (excluding those four $refs, already resolved by Related). No lifecycleActions: status is a plain draft/applied enum with no x-openregister-lifecycle map (the PayrollRunDetail precedent -- design.md D8); the page-level 'Herrekenen' api-call is the only action, guarded server-side by PayrollController::adjust() (404 unresolvable/unauthorized, 400 already-applied). Audit history is a sidebar tab.
